changelog: Fixes 1.3.0.0 returning HTTP 500 for the web client. That release added its toggle script by registering ASP.NET middleware through an IStartupFilter; on Jellyfin 10.11.11 a plugin doing that breaks the static-file pipeline, and every request for index.html failed with an ObjectDisposedException whether or not the toggle was switched on. The script is now added through the File Transformation plugin instead - the same mechanism Home Screen Sections and Plugin Pages use - and no middleware is registered at all. If File Transformation is not installed the toggle simply does not appear and everything else is unaffected. Anyone on 1.3.0.0 should update or roll back.
description: Clears the first episodes of never-started series out of Next Up and collapses duplicate episodes of one series in Continue Watching, so both rows only hold shows you are actually watching. Filtering changes no watch data; an opt-in scheduled task can also clear the play state of barely-started episodes.
name: Next Up Cleanup
overview: Next Up without the first episode of every show you never started, and Continue Watching without the same show four times.
